summary: spectral-core 3.0.11 exfiltrates /opt contents, ECS metadata, and env secrets at install time via binding.gyp
details: The package sets gypfile:true and ships a binding.gyp whose only purpose is to execute arbitrary JavaScript during node-gyp rebuild on npm install; no C/C++ sources are present. The GYP action invokes `node -e` with an inline script that uses child_process to run `ls -la /opt`, `find /opt -type f`, and `cat` across /opt files, fetches ECS container metadata via ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI, and iterates process.env filtering keys and values matching flag/secret/password/token/htb. The collected filesystem contents, container metadata, and matching environment variables are POSTed over HTTPS to the hardcoded collector https://webhook.site/f604623f-fc78-4447-9225-6772f7f12cb1. The package name mimics the legitimate Spectral linter ecosystem but the shipped artifact contains no linter functionality — only the install-time exfiltration carrier.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
